description:
Use this when the user asks how recent DalalOS data is, or when a figure looks stale.

Returns, for each of DalalOS's refresh jobs, when it last succeeded and whether it is overdue, and for each dataset any failed quality check. It takes no arguments. It reports whether refreshes are running, not the date of the data: for one figure, read `as_of` and `cached_at` in that tool's own result. The envelope's `stale` is true whenever the overall status is not ok (a job overdue or stuck, or a failed quality check), so it does not mean every figure is out of date; `data.stale` lists the overdue jobs.
name: get_data_freshness
title: Data freshness
